description: SSR visual fixes and 21st.dev component upgrades — fix AnimatedSection invisible below-fold bug, replace LocalPackVisual with SSR-safe 21st.dev component, upgrade TrustBar with stat callouts via 21st.dev, and add useReducedMotion accessibility guard

userStories.title: Fix AnimatedSection SSR visibility bug
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want all page content to be visible on first paint so that I can read the page regardless of JavaScript execution state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a useMounted guard to AnimatedSection.tsx: useState(false) that flips true in useEffect
Gate the initial prop on mounted: initial={mounted ? 'hidden' : false} so SSR HTML carries no opacity/transform inline styles
Gate animate prop: animate={isInView ? 'visible' : (mounted ? 'hidden' : false)}
All three pages (/, /services, /about) show fully visible below-fold sections when JS is disabled (verify with curl or browser devtools)
Framer Motion entrance animation (fade + slide) still plays on scroll when JS is enabled
The direction and delay prop API is unchanged — no callers require updates
Do NOT remove the 'use client' directive
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Root cause: Framer Motion serialises initial='hidden' variant styles (opacity:0, translateY:24px) as inline styles in SSR HTML. useMounted guard ensures SSR HTML renders at opacity:1/y:0 while preserving the scroll-reveal animation after hydration.

userStories.title: Replace LocalPackVisual with SSR-safe component via 21st.dev
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want to see a recognisable Google local pack mockup in the Hero section on first paint so that I immediately understand what Foundational AI Systems delivers for clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Use mcp__21st-dev-magic__21st_magic_component_builder with this prompt: 'Generate a Google local pack search result mockup card component for a dark-themed Next.js marketing site. The card should show a stylised city map background with pin markers, and a list of 3 ranked local business listings each with a rank number badge, business name, star rating, and review count. No Framer Motion — use CSS transitions only for hover states. Background: #021524. Accent/gold colour: #C9A227. Text colours: primary #d1e5fb, muted #99907b, border/outline #99907b at 30% opacity. Fully static, no animation on mount — must render correctly with JavaScript disabled.'
Save generated output as components/LocalPackCard.tsx
Wire in the three listings: Apex Plumbing Co. (4.9 stars, 312 reviews), BlueLine HVAC (4.8 stars, 187 reviews), Summit Electric (4.7 stars, 241 reviews)
In HeroSection.tsx swap import LocalPackVisual to import LocalPackCard and update JSX — the AnimatedSection wrapper stays
Component must be a Server Component (no 'use client') unless the generated output requires it
LocalPackCard renders fully visible on first paint — no opacity:0 or transform inline styles in SSR HTML
Playwright screenshot at 1280px shows the card rendered in the hero — not dark or blank
Delete components/LocalPackVisual.tsx after all criteria pass
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Depends on US-032 being merged first. LocalPackVisual has its own internal motion.div with initial='hidden' that is independent of the AnimatedSection wrapper — both must be fixed. A flat colour background is acceptable if 21st.dev doesn't produce an SVG map.

userStories.title: Upgrade TrustBar with stat callouts via 21st.dev
userStories.description: As a prospective client, I want to see concrete social proof figures alongside the industry pills in the trust bar so that I have immediate evidence of Foundational AI Systems' track record.
acceptanceCriteria: Use mcp__21st-dev-magic__21st_magic_component_builder with this prompt: 'Generate a trust bar component for a dark-themed Next.js landing page. It should have two rows: a top row of 3 stat callouts (large bold number + short label beneath it), and a second row of 4 industry pill tags. Fully static, no animations, no JavaScript required. Background transparent (inherits parent). Stat number colour: #C9A227. Stat label colour: #99907b. Pill background: #0e2131. Pill border: white at 10% opacity. Pill text: #99907b. Add a faint divider between rows. Mobile-first: stats stack 1-column on mobile (375px), 3-column on desktop (1280px).'
Save as components/TrustBar.tsx (overwrite existing)
Wire in stats as a const array at top of file: [{value: '47+', label: 'Local businesses ranked'}, {value: '4.8★', label: 'Average client rating'}, {value: '68%', label: 'Leads recovered'}]
Wire in pills as a const array: ['Restaurants', 'Law Firms', 'Home Services', 'Dental']
No props needed — all data hardcoded
Component must be a Server Component (no 'use client' directive)
Three stat callouts visible: 47+, 4.8★, 68% with correct labels
Stat numbers rendered in #C9A227
No layout shift on mobile (375px) and desktop (1280px)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Independent of US-032 and US-033 — can be implemented in any order relative to those. TrustBar is currently a Server Component and must stay that way.

userStories.title: Add useReducedMotion guard to AnimatedSection
userStories.description: As a user with 'Reduce Motion' enabled in OS accessibility settings, I want page animations suppressed so I am not at risk of motion-triggered discomfort.
acceptanceCriteria: AnimatedSection.tsx calls Framer Motion's useReducedMotion() hook
When prefersReducedMotion is true, children render immediately at their final visible state — no fade, no translate, no delay
When prefersReducedMotion is false or null, existing scroll-reveal behaviour is unchanged
The direction and delay prop API is unchanged
Typecheck passes
Manually verified by enabling Reduce Motion in macOS System Settings > Accessibility and reloading the page — sections appear instantly with no motion
userStories.notes: Depends on US-032 being merged first. Do not change the AnimatedSection prop API. Do not gate behind a feature flag.
